parsed.title: PROTECT & SERVE
parsed.body:
All [intruder] in each [ICON: white outlined horizontal four-lobed glyph] move.
Then, all [intruder] in every Room move.

Place 2 Drones in the Room/Corridor
with the Queen – they do not Attack.
If there is no Queen on the map,
add 2 random Drone tokens to the bag.

Each [character] in a Room without a [ICON: white shield-like glyph with broad flat top and forked lower point]
resolves [ICON: yellow spiked burst with black central glyph].
